recognize_zh: 低倍迴腸切片的 CD20 免疫染色中，大片瀰漫浸潤的腫瘤細胞全部呈強棕色陽性，填滿腸壁並包圍殘存的黏膜與腺體（棕色背景下的淡色結構呈陰性），證實為 B 細胞來源的淋巴瘤。
features: Low-power view of small bowel wall with a large, diffuse infiltrate
Strong, uniform brown CD20 membranous staining in sheets of lymphoma cells
Residual mucosa/villi and glands on the left are CD20 negative
Infiltrate expands the wall in broad confluent sheets with interspersed negative vessels/spaces
Scattered positive cells extend into surrounding tissue at the edges
describe_en: Low-power immunohistochemical stain for CD20 on an ileal resection shows a diffuse, sheet-like lymphoid infiltrate expanding the bowel wall. The neoplastic cells show strong, uniform membranous CD20 expression, while residual mucosa and glandular epithelium are negative. Individual cell size cannot be assessed at this magnification. Findings confirm B-cell lineage of the infiltrate and, together with the large atypical cells on H&E, are consistent with diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving the ileum.

ddx.vs: Also CD20+ and common in the ileocecal region but composed of monotonous medium-sized cells with starry-sky pattern, CD10+/BCL2-, Ki-67 near 100%, and MYC rearrangement.
CD20+ but composed of small centrocyte-like/monocytoid cells with lymphoepithelial lesions and a low proliferation index.
CD20+ but co-expresses CD5 and cyclin D1/SOX11 and shows small to medium cells with irregular nuclei.
Tumor cells would be keratin positive and CD20/CD45 negative, arising from the mucosal epithelium.
